bullets.title: ROKU / FOXA: Fox acquires Roku for $160/sh, $22B EV in cash-and-stock
bullets.body: Fox Corp agreed to buy Roku for $96 cash + 0.9693 FOXA shares per share (~$160 total), valuing the platform at ~$22B enterprise value. FOXA expects $400M run-rate cost synergies and FCF accretion by year 2; pro forma leverage ~2.8x. Deal closes H1 2027, pending shareholder and regulatory approval; combined entity becomes 3rd-largest US TV player by viewing share. Baird downgraded ROKU to Neutral at $160 PT (no upside); FOXA -13% on deal announcement.

bullets.title: WDC / STX: Morgan Stanley raises PTs dramatically on HDD super-cycle
bullets.body: MS raised WDC PT to $650 (bull case $920, implying potential share doubling) and STX to $1,035 on 30%+ nearline exabyte growth and accelerating pricing. MS sees WDC/STX potentially 10x EPS between CY25-CY28 under bullish pricing scenarios; HDD demand strengthening through CY28 from cloud and AI inferencing. Both names flagged as sandbagging with ~90% sequential incremental GMs.

bullets.title: MU / STX / WDC: Semis rally 5-8% pre-market on risk-on backdrop
bullets.body: Micron +8%, Seagate +7.5%, Western Digital +7.1% in pre-market on US-Iran deal and favorable AI demand backdrop. Korea memory names also up ~10% overnight. JPM semi desk notes strong dip-buying in semis after earlier selling; STX and WDC pricing-driven upside with higher run-rate potential.

bullets.title: ACN: Morgan Stanley downgrades to Equal-Weight, cuts PT to $177 from $240
bullets.body: MS's James Faucette downgraded Accenture to EW as AI spending crowds out traditional IT services demand; PT cut to $177 vs. current ~$170, implying only 4% upside. ACN earnings due June 18 with consensus organic CC growth at +1.5% to +2.5%; 50% of investors see risk of negative FY27 organic growth. FactSet consensus PT $235 (range $177-$320), suggesting significant Street PT cuts likely follow.

bullets.title: AMD: Pre-quiet period call bullish; $25-30 bull-case EPS power, MI-450 ramp on track
bullets.body: Wolfe takeaways from AMD pre-quiet period call: MI-450 shipping late 3Q with significant 4Q revenue jump; Meta and OpenAI are two largest customers driving MI-400 ramp with crossover to MI-450 in 4Q. Bull case: $14 base EPS + $7 from CPU demand + $3-4 per GW of MI-450 = $25-30 EPS power at under 20x. Citi also upgraded AMD, raising 2026-2028 EPS estimates 12-13% above consensus on meaningful GPU share gains at Meta vs. NVDA.

bullets.title: TXN: Citi raises PT to $345 as top pick on 800V DC data-center power opportunity
bullets.body: Citi raised TXN PT from $280 to $345 (Buy) on the 800V DC transition driving >70% CAGR in data center power delivery from ~$2B (2026) to ~$12B (2028). TXN is one of few high-voltage GaN vendors with internal manufacturing capacity quadrupled since Oct 2024. Also opening upside Catalyst Watch on ON Semi (PT $120 from $100) ahead of September 16 Analyst Day on SiC momentum.

bullets.title: CRM: Acquires Fin (Intercom) for ~$3.6B to expand Agentforce AI agent capabilities
bullets.body: Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Fin (formerly Intercom) for ~$3.6B. Fin's AI agent resolves complex customer queries across chat, email, WhatsApp, SMS, phone, and Slack, complementing Agentforce. Transaction expected to close in Q4 FY27 with no impact to FY27 guidance or capital return program.

bullets.title: ORCL: Mizuho raises PT to $320; buying opportunity as capex/financing concerns ease
bullets.body: Mizuho reiterated Outperform on ORCL after its 10% post-FQ4 dip, raising PT to $320 (21x FY30E EPS). IaaS accelerated to 90%+ YoY in FQ4; FY27 gross capex ~$90-95B nets to ~$70B cash outlay (vs. $100B Street estimates); four customers each signed $8B+ contracts. RPO +363% YoY to $638B; BYOC/prepayment contracts carry similar or better margins. Wolfe also bullish: Oracle plays 'tokens and business outcomes' layer with durable growth.

bullets.title: DDOG: Truist upgrades to Buy, $300 PT; Wolfe raises PT to $295 on agentic AI upside
bullets.body: Truist upgraded Datadog to Buy from Hold, raising PT to $300 from $190 (~30% upside). Wolfe also raised DDOG PT to $295 on larger TAM, agent-driven token consumption, and GPU monitoring/LLM observability growth (+30x YoY). 82% of DDOG customers expect NTM spending growth vs. 75% prior; 25% spending significantly more YoY.

bullets.title: FSLR: Mizuho raises PT 23% to $300 on tariff-driven US solar ASP upside
bullets.body: Mizuho raised FSLR PT to $300 (from prior) as Section 232 action on polysilicon expected July/August could push US module ASPs to $0.36-0.38/W base case or above $0.40/W in bull case. CSIQ also raised to $18 PT but remains Neutral pending FEOC uncertainty. US solar demand impact limited as tariff capex headwind only ~5-10%.

bullets.title: CCL / RCL: Morgan Stanley flags CCL as most oil-leveraged cruise play post Iran deal
bullets.body: MS notes CCL is mostly unhedged to oil: a 10% oil move equals ~5% earnings impact vs. ~1% for RCL (60% hedged). Cruise sector is the most positively impacted consumer group from lower oil prices. US-Iran Strait of Hormuz agreement expected to drive oil lower, providing a direct earnings tailwind.

bullets.title: NVDA: Consensus bullish; rack shipments 75k units CY26, 100-110k CY27; crowding elevated
bullets.body: NVDA rack shipments forecast at 75k units in CY26, rising to 100-110k in CY27 per Jefferies. Google/SpaceX multi-year deal paying $920M/month for 110k NVDA GPUs through June 2029; Anthropic deal at $1.25B/month for 220k+ GPUs. UBS notes semiconductor crowding approaching record 2021 levels with NVDA at +25.1 crowding score. Stock flat for ~10 months despite AI demand.

bullets.title: WBD / PSKY: DOJ approves Paramount's $111B acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery
bullets.body: Department of Justice approved PSKY's acquisition of WBD, creating a major media consolidation. PSKY +3.7% pre-market; however, California officials signaling potential opposition to the DOJ-approved deal, adding regulatory uncertainty. PSKY's Scary Movie has grossed $84.6M to date.

bullets.title: ADBE: Wolfe downgrades to Perform; organic ARR guide cut ~$480M, CEO/CFO departures
bullets.body: ADBE downgraded to Perform by Wolfe on -3% YoY NNARR decline (ex-Semrush), CEO and CFO departures, and unclear freemium payback timeline. ADBE fell 18.8% last week. AI ARR growing 3x YoY but total TTM NNARR still declined. UBS also flagged ADBE shifting to freemium as reflecting AI's deflationary impact on software economics.

bullets.title: SNOW / MDB: Data infrastructure stocks outperforming amid software weakness
bullets.body: Snowflake +58% past month and MongoDB +15% as AI data/infra names diverge from the broader software selloff (app software index down 35%+ from ATH). Snowflake positioned as agentic control plane with path to durable 30%+ growth and GAAP profitability by FY28. MDB trading at 44% discount to peers as critical data platform for enterprise agents.

bullets.title: BE (Besi): Morgan Stanley OW, €300 PT; investor day June 18 may raise hybrid bonding targets
bullets.body: MS maintains OW on BE Semiconductor into the June 18 Amsterdam investor day, expecting the company to raise long-term financial targets and hybrid bonding guidance. Optical networking is cited as the fastest-growing opportunity (~10% of revenue now). MS is 15% ahead of Street on non-hybrid bonding revenue in FY26 (62% growth vs. 41% consensus). JPM also raised PT 29% to €342 on expected guidance hikes.

bullets.title: AVGO: Leads $35B Anthropic chip securitization deal; first IG-rated chip-backed security
bullets.body: AVGO, Blackstone, and Apollo announced a $35B capital solution for Anthropic compute infrastructure with AVGO developing custom TPU chips for training/deployment. The chip securitization features $6B A1 notes, $25B A2 notes, $4.5B B notes. GS also warned of headwinds from V9 packaging redesign (EMIB availability) and MediaTek share gains at Google/TPU. Compute preference hierarchy per UBS: NVDA > MRVL > AMD > ARM > AVGO.

bullets.title: GOOGL / AMZN: Wolfe raises estimates on Anthropic-driven cloud acceleration
bullets.body: Wolfe raised GCP revenue growth to 81% for 2026 vs. Street at 63%, with Anthropic accounting for 25-30% of GCP revenue in 2027-28. AWS growth raised to 37% in 2026 vs. Street at 30%, with Anthropic driving ~30% of AWS revenue in 2027. GOOGL 2027 EPS raised to $15.27 and AMZN 2027 EPS to $10.45. CapEx rising to $300B (2027) and $400B (2028) for GOOGL. UBS also notes META and AMZN showing stronger near-term ad trajectories vs. GOOGL.

bullets.title: WSM / RH: Retail coverage outperforming; WSM at all-time high, RH most shorted
bullets.body: Citi US retail coverage up +2% June MTD vs. S&P -2%; WSM at all-time high as only stock within 10% of ATH. Group trades at -9% discount to 5-year FY2 P/E. RH is most shorted at 37% of float. Home improvement group outperformed +4% vs. S&P +1% on improving macro; pent-up demand and rate trajectory are the key debate.

bullets.title: MSFT: Xbox spinoff not ruled out; tokenmaxxing signals AI cost pressure
bullets.body: Microsoft has not ruled out spinning off Xbox division per recent reports. Separately, Meta and Microsoft are implementing 'tokenmaxxing/token minimization' due to surging AI inference costs, with Satya Nadella signaling a shift toward open-source frameworks. UBS notes MSFT seeing green shoots from CoPilot/CoWork deployments and Super-App bundling strategy.
